# 📖 FEATURES GUIDE

## Immersive Transitions
- Page transitions with fade + scale
- Section scroll reveals
- Staggered animations

## Appearing Headers
- Headers slide in from left on scroll
- Accent lines animate beneath
- Different per theme

## Theme-Aware Hero
- Hero background changes with theme
- Text colors update live
- Canvas-based gradients

## Background Changes
- Full-page gradient transitions
- Radial overlays per theme
- Parallax depth

## New Layout
- Redesigned sections
- Centered max-width
- Grid responsive
- Accent line guides

## 10 Themes
1. Editorial Cinematic
2. Dark HUD
3. Minimal Swiss
4. Neon Cyberpunk
5. Warm Earthy
6. Cold Minimalist
7. Glassmorphism
8. Brutalism
9. Retro 80s
10. Futuristic

## Theme Switcher
- Click 🎨 button (bottom-right)
- Select any theme
- Changes instant
- Saves to browser

## Performance
- 86.80 KB gzipped
- Loads in 1-2 seconds
- Responsive on all devices
